title: Semester and Yearbook
author: Isandro Nakamura
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
